title: API proposal : Remove singleRefine from RefinementList
body:
It seems to me that this parameter is redundant with the menu.

Since the menu is already handling disjunctive + single refine, it is here only for conjunctive faceting.
We have two options:

* If we're considering single value attributes => Then it's already the only refinement displayed
* If we're considering array attributes => Then why limit the user in his filtering abilities ?
